title: Entitled & Stubborn: Girl Turns into a Maniac Once She’s Cuffed
description:
On February 22nd, 2023, an officer on patrol noticed a lady approaching different vehicles with a cup in her hand. He approached her and asked if she needed help with something. She mentioned having been in a fight with her boyfriend, who drove away with her purse in the car. As soon as the officer ran the lady’s name through his records, he found out that she had a warrant out for her arrest. Shortly after, the officer found out that the woman had a warrant issued in her name. The woman began behaving in an agitated manner once the officers started searching her. She was soon transported to jail for further processing, but she was very uncooperative. The officers were able to get her out of the car, but soon she began kicking them. She continued to make the situation even more difficult for the officers. She wasn't showing any signs of stopping her resistance. Later, she began refusing to go to the hospital for a medical check-up. The woman had previous warrants and was charged with resisting arrest.

About Us / Disclaimer: 

Police Insider provides unbiased and authentic footage of incidents captured on body cams. We believe this footage can be used as an educational guide for viewers. 

We only provide unique and original content that hasn’t been covered before on YouTube.

The raw footage for the videos on this channel have been obtained directly from the respective Police Departments. We as a media company have the right to use it commercially. Most incidents may require a fee associated with the request and take several days to process.

The channel is not affiliated with any law enforcement agency.

Our channel is compliant with YouTube's Fair Use Policy as we create a storyline and cut down several hours of long footage to a few minutes to bring out the most entertaining and educational parts, just like other channels such as Code Blue Cam, Real World Police, Active Police Cam, Blue Watch and Bodycam FIles.

The featured content is NOT intended to publicly shame, ridicule, or degrade the individuals involved or to glorify violence in any way.
